mcq_drop.why: opinion item ('historical debate' on women's status)
dubious: Satavahana records already dated by year, fortnight and day

patterns: No PYQs filed here; APPSC asks this as 'the woman who served Buddhism most' = Bodhisri (G2 2018, 2019) with Chamtisri/Bapisri as distractors.
Expect single-fact items on Nagarjunakonda donors, Santamula's Vedic sacrifices and titles, and guild names (Parnika = betel, Poosika = sweetmeat).
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement items on fine donor genealogy, deeper than the typical APPSC one-liner.
